hook: Hang vines on your strongest unit and every buff it gets ripples down a whole tree of climbers.
loop: Play climbers onto a host; Climb copies half its gains.
Chains of climbers on climbers, or tiny roots that Bloom.
One buff on the host pays out down the whole tree.

growth.line: Every host gain copies at half down chains; Lattice and Hedera make it full, late growth snowballs.

feel.early: Small copied buffs; Sprig and Woodbine carry thin bodies.
feel.mid: Choose your tree: one big host, spread, or Bloom.
feel.late: Missel, Hedera and Viscum make deep chains grow fast.

stars.why: Climbs the enemy, steals stats, and feeds its own climbers.
Blooms on a tiny root, then +4/+4 cascades down chains.
Counts your tree, grows the root, shields the weak point.

card_short.u01: Climb; when played, buffs its host permanently.
card_short.u02: Climbs two hosts at once, copying half from each.
card_short.u03: Climb; End of Turn, buffs its host permanently.
card_short.u04: Climb; drains 1/1 from its host each turn.
card_short.u05: Climb; gold each turn on your biggest, well-climbed host.
card_short.u06: Climb; sprouts Ivy Shoots climbing it into empty slots.
card_short.u07: In fight, climbs the enemy across and steals a quarter.
card_short.u08: Climb; buffs its host once per climber in the tree.
card_short.u09: Climb; Start of Combat, buffs its host for the fight.
card_short.u10: Climb; End of Turn, buffs every unit that has a climber.
card_short.u11: Climb; your other climbers can move onto its host, growing.
card_short.u12: Climb; its own climbers copy all its gains, not half.
card_short.u13: Bloom: gains Cleave, gives its host Damage Reduction.
card_short.u14: Grows your most-climbed unit per climber; gives it Shield.
card_short.u15: In fight, climbs the biggest enemy, steals; re-climbs on kills.
card_short.u16: Bloom: Start of Combat, gives your other climbers +4/+4.
card_short.u17: All your climbers copy full gains; re-climbs your biggest unit.
card_short.u18: Buffs every friendly unit per blooming climber you have.
card_short.u19: Climbers whose host dies inherit a third for the fight.
card_short.x01: A 2/2 token climber made by Ivy Runner.
card_short.x02: Spell: move one climber onto any friendly unit.

builds.name: The Grand Oak
builds.line: Pile climbers onto one strong host; Missel and Hedera pay off.

builds.name: The Hedge
builds.line: Many small trees with Hop Bine; no single death breaks it.

builds.name: The Overgrown Ruin
builds.line: Tiny roots let Ruin Ivy and Ivy in Flower Bloom.

liked: Bloom flips the rule: tiny roots like Shoots or Eggs become prized.
Dodders stealing from enemies, and Cousin Dodder plus Old Man's Beard's kill-and-feast.
worries: Watch Lady Hedera, Missel, Viscum: full share down deep chains grows very fast.
Watch Old Man's Beard swinging fights, Hanger-on's easy gold; Cousin Dodder's rules unclear.
changed: Climb now spells out falling, loops and triples; Hedera can't climb her climbers.
Dodder Thread now leaves its host, steals, and climbs back after kills.
Hanger-on pays more on a three-climber host; Mistletoe now only drains.
verdict: Combo players who love planning a tree: every buff on the host ripples down a chain of climbers.
